author: Home Repair Tutor
description:
I need to repair this plywood subfloor. The first step is to apply a 1/2 inch bead of Great Stuff Construction Adhesive. I slowly lower the panel and fasten it to the floor joists every 4 to 6 inches with 2-inch screws. This repair won’t creak and is very strong, which is important for the freestanding tub being installed over it

Learn more about Great Stuff Construction Adhesive at https://www.greatstuff.dupont.com/products/greatstuff-construction-adhesive.html?src=gs_na_paid-social_fy26greatstuff-influencer_youtube_v-homerepairtutor4-plt_2026-08-19
